entities.summary: Douglas Newton Everett was an American ice hockey player. He was a star for the Dartmouth College hockey team in 1922-26 and a member of Sigma Chi Fraternity. After graduating, Everett received professional offers from the Boston Bruins, New York Rangers and Toronto Maple Leafs of the National Hockey League but opted to pursue a career in the insurance business in Concord, New Hampshire instead while continuing to play amateur hockey.
